justification: GST-1350 no-loss check (test/review-risk-token-paths.test.ts, 'GST-1350 no-loss check'): a token-named style or engine file (gd, css, scss, sass, less, styl: TOKEN_SOURCE) is a secret and gate path only when its changed lines hold a secret the credential scanner reads or have no text; every other token-named file (code such as lib/token.ts, json, yaml, binary) stays a secret path by name as on main; dotenv files, SSH private keys and key-store extensions become secret and gate paths by name; lib/redact-engine.ts and lib/redact-patterns.ts become gate paths. On the GST-967 history grid over eleven cases (3,168 planReview cases with targetedClasses), stand-in paths reproduce main's plans at b244e6d byte for byte (bafc2b53). On the real paths the branch lowers only the two benign token-named style and engine cases (scripts/ui/token.gd, ui/tokens.css: gate/full to code/light, the fix); theme/token.ts, a token file holding a key-shaped value, token.json, a binary tokens.db, secrets/ and credentials.json keep main's plans, and .env, id_rsa and server.pem rise from code/light to gate/full keeping every reader main dispatched, with GST-972's Red Team split (252 checklist slots of light's batched reader move to full depth's batched reader at the specialist effort while the Red Team keeps full effort as its own dispatch). Over the last 100 first-parent main commits to b244e6d (288 histories each, 28,800 plans, collectCommit with scope {} and gate scan 0), the branch plans what main planned on 98; the other two (0b19a36, 5fdfa14, both editing lib/redact-patterns.ts) rise from code/full to gate/full, drop no reader and lower no effort (71 of 288 histories gain the Step 11 voices). No commit in that range touches a token-named, dotenv or key path
